tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It rains/rained 的 rain 是動詞；It is/was rainy 的 rainy 是形容詞。There is/was＋rain/snow；We/They have/had＋rain/snow。先看主詞，再看時間。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，搭配 much、a little 或 a lot of，不用 many 或 a few。There 開頭用 is/was；We/They 開頭用 have/had。現在習慣如 every winter 用 is/have；過去時間如 last winter 用 was/had。問句是 Is/Was there ...? 或 Do/Did we/they have ...?；did 後的 have 用原形。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: ___ was the weather when the fisherman left yesterday?
quiz.hint: 後面沒有 like，詢問天氣用 How was the weather。

quiz.question: A: ___ is the weather like by the sea today? B: It is windy.
quiz.hint: 問句保留 like，開頭要用 What。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather outside now? I need to choose a coat.
quiz.hint: now 指現在；the weather 是單數，使用 is。

quiz.question: What ___ the weather like before the shower yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去；描述天氣用 be 動詞 was。

quiz.question: A: What is the weather ___ this morning? B: Cloudy.
quiz.hint: 詢問天氣的固定句型是 What is the weather like?，like 不變化。

quiz.question: How ___ the weather at the lake last Sunday?
quiz.hint: last Sunday 是過去時間，the weather 搭配 was。

quiz.question: ___ is the weather near the river now? Do we need umbrellas?
quiz.hint: 沒有 like，用 How is the weather 詢問天氣。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather like on your first day in Japan?
quiz.hint: 看到 the weather like，應選 What 組成天氣問句。

quiz.question: A: How ___ the weather today? B: It is sunny and warm.
quiz.hint: 回答用 It is，問句也用現在式的 is。

quiz.question: What was the weather ___ when you visited the farm?
quiz.hint: What was the weather like 是過去式天氣問句，like 維持原形。

quiz.question: Look at the clear sky! It ___ sunny now.
quiz.hint: sunny 是形容詞；now 表示現在，用 It is sunny。

quiz.question: The fisherman stayed home yesterday. It ___ very windy then.
quiz.hint: then 指前句的 yesterday，過去天氣用 was＋形容詞。

quiz.question: It is ___ today, so the roads are wet.
quiz.hint: is 後需要天氣形容詞 rainy，不能直接接動詞 rains 或 rained。

quiz.question: It was ___ last night, and the hills turned white.
quiz.hint: was 後接形容詞 snowy；snowed 是動詞過去式。

quiz.question: It ___ cloudy above the island at the moment.
quiz.hint: at the moment 表示現在，主詞 It 搭配 is。

quiz.question: It ___ cold when we walked home last night.
quiz.hint: last night 是過去，主詞 It 搭配 was。

quiz.question: In this season, it is often ___ near the sea.
quiz.hint: is 後用表示天氣的形容詞 windy。

quiz.question: It ___ rainy during our visit to the village yesterday.
quiz.hint: rainy 是形容詞，且 yesterday 是過去時間，因此用 was。

quiz.question: A: Was it snowy on your trip? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: Was it 開頭的過去式問句，否定簡答用 it wasn't。

quiz.question: A: Is it sunny at the beach now? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Is it 開頭的現在式問句，肯定簡答用 it is。

quiz.question: Take an umbrella in this season. It often ___ here.
quiz.hint: often 提示習慣，主詞 It 的一般現在式動詞用 rains。

quiz.question: It ___ all night yesterday, so the ground was wet.
quiz.hint: yesterday 提示過去；rain 的過去式是 rained。

quiz.question: It usually ___ on these high mountains in January.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣，主詞 It 搭配第三人稱單數 snows。

quiz.question: It ___ near our hotel three days ago.
quiz.hint: three days ago 是過去時間，用 snowed。

quiz.question: Does it ___ often near the sea in this season?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 Does 後面的動詞用原形 rain。

quiz.question: Did it ___ while you were in the mountains yesterday?
quiz.hint: Did 已表示過去，後面用原形 snow。

quiz.question: It doesn't ___ much on this island in winter.
quiz.hint: doesn't 後面的動詞用原形 rain。

quiz.question: It didn't ___ during our visit to Japan last month.
quiz.hint: didn't 後面要用原形 snow，不能再用過去式。

quiz.question: ___ it rain here every autumn? I want to plant trees.
quiz.hint: every autumn 表示習慣，It 是第三人稱單數，問句用 Does。

quiz.question: ___ it snow in the village two nights ago?
quiz.hint: two nights ago 是過去時間；snow 是原形動詞，搭配 Did。

quiz.question: A: Did it rain before the game? B: Yes, it ___.
quiz.hint: Did it rain 的肯定簡答用 it did。

quiz.question: A: Does it snow on this island? B: No, it ___.
quiz.hint: Does 開頭的現在式問句，否定簡答用 doesn't。

quiz.question: The fisherman says it ___ a lot here every spring.
quiz.hint: every spring 提示現在習慣，It 後用 rains。

quiz.question: We couldn't see the road because it ___ heavily last night.
quiz.hint: last night 指過去，snow 應改為 snowed。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain near the sea every summer.
quiz.hint: There 開頭、rain 是不可數名詞，現在習慣用 There is。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow outside our hotel yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，There 後搭配 was，不用 had。

quiz.question: Look! There ___ heavy snow on the mountain now.
quiz.hint: now 表示現在，snow 是不可數名詞，用 There is。

quiz.question: There ___ very little rain during our trip last April.
quiz.hint: last April 是過去時間，There was 後接不可數名詞 rain。

quiz.question: There ___ usually a lot of rain here in this season.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣；There 搭配 is，不能用 have。

quiz.question: There ___ no snow in the town last winter.
quiz.hint: last winter 表示過去，snow 是不可數名詞，用 was。

quiz.question: We ___ heavy rain here every September.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 描述雨量時用 have；every September 表示習慣。

quiz.question: We ___ very little rain on our farm last spring.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 描述雨量用 have，過去時間 last spring 改用 had。

quiz.question: They ___ a lot of snow in their country every year.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 搭配 have，every year 提示現在習慣。

quiz.question: They ___ heavy rain during the festival last weekend.
quiz.hint: They 描述雨量用 have，last weekend 是過去，改用 had。

quiz.question: We usually ___ a little rain here in autumn.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣；主詞 We 搭配 have 描述雨量。

quiz.question: They ___ no snow in their village last December.
quiz.hint: last December 是過去時間，They 後用 had 描述雪量。

quiz.question: There wasn't ___ rain during the trip.
quiz.hint: rain 是不可數名詞，否定句中用 much 表示大量。

quiz.question: We had ___ snow last night, but the roads were still open.
quiz.hint: snow 是不可數名詞，表示少量用 a little。

quiz.question: Did we ___ much rain here last October?
quiz.hint: 主詞是 we，描述雨量用 have，不用 is／was；問句已有 Did，後面的 have 用原形，不能用 had。

quiz.question: Was there ___ snow outside the school yesterday?
quiz.hint: snow 不可數，用 much；many、a few、several 修飾可數名詞。
